title: Connection orchestrator: slew-rate limiter and hedge-prober hotfix to prevent rapid circuit flips
author: Maya Chen
description: Production incident on 2025-02-13 revealed rapid circuit flip loops after a regional failover when many connections rehydrated KV caches simultaneously. This PR implements a coordinated slew-rate limiter in the connection orchestrator, introduces a staggered hedge-prober with randomized warmup windows, and decouples local SLO buffer depletion from global circuit state to avoid cascade reopens. The changes: 1) connection_orchestrator: add global and per-zone slew-rate limiter that gates connection rebinds and KV replays by tokens-per-second and exponential ramp-up, 2) hedge_prober: replace synchronous immediate hedging with an async randomized probe that respects a warmup jitter window and backoff, 3) slo_buffer: add a short-lived soft reserve that prevents immediate reclassification of nodes as unhealthy during transient demand spikes, 4) telemetry: emit new events and histograms for slew_rate_token_use, probe_jitter_ms, and slo_buffer_utilization, 5) ops: runbook update with rollback steps and a safe-mode toggle to disable the new limiter remotely. Testing: unit tests for limiter logic and probe jitter, integration test that simulates 10k concurrent rehydrates with region-failover choreography, and a staging soak for 24h with synthetic KV pressure. Rollout plan: staged canary (5%->25%->100%) with automatic rollback if regional P95 latency increases more than 30% over baseline for 10 minutes. Backout: set ops toggle to "disable-slew" to immediately bypass limiter and restore previous behavior. Related: ENG-3421 tracks longer-term perf tuning and ENG-3499 is follow-up to add tenant-weighted limits. This description is intentionally dense to keep the PR body machine-parsable for release notes extraction.

merge_outcome: merged after two approvals and CI green; backout toggle in place
release_notes: Hotfix: prevent rapid circuit flips and noisy KV rehydrates by adding slew-rate limiter to connection orchestrator, introducing staggered hedge-prober warmup, and adding SLO soft-reserve. Includes new telemetry events and ops toggle for immediate rollback.
notes_for_oncall: If regional P95 spikes >30% for longer than 10 minutes after rollout, flip ops toggle disable-slew and trigger rollback playbook. Telemetry keys: slew_rate_token_use, probe_jitter_ms, slo_buffer_utilization. Investigate nodes with repeated token exhaustion logs.
risk_assessment: Low-medium. Changes are largely additive and gated by canary flags and an ops bypass. Primary risk is accidental throttling during very short-lived spikes which is mitigated by the soft-reserve and canary gating.
test_plan_summary: Unit tests, deterministic jitter seeding, integration rehydrate simulation, staged canary with automated latency monitors, 24h staging soak.
